import hashlib, sys, time
buf = b"x" * 1024
n = 0
t0 = time.monotonic()
deadline = t0 + float(sys.argv[1])
while time.monotonic() < deadline:
    hashlib.sha256(buf).digest()
    n += 1
    if (n & 4095) == 0:
        sys.stderr.write(f"python3 sha256 ops={n} elapsed_s={time.monotonic()-t0:.6f}\n")
        sys.stderr.flush()
sys.stderr.write(f"python3 sha256 ops={n} elapsed_s={time.monotonic()-t0:.6f}\n")
